## Context / Problem
`src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/` is package data imported by path: `_loader.py::lazy_load`, the in-package loader prologues and hand-rolled sibling loaders, and out-of-package loaders (`_lib_ops._engine_module`, `_bridge_commands._ref_lock_module`, `mcp_server._load_engine_mode`, `infra/scripts/comment_echo_reclaim_manifest.py:28-39`, four `sys.path.insert` sites, `_engine.engine_env`'s PYTHONPATH prepend). The generic top-level name breaks namespace hygiene, the by-path idiom forces a `sys.modules` key contract onto ~340 test files, and mypy widens every `rebar_reconciler.`-imported annotation to `Any`. Operator decision (2026-09-06), BREAKING: the package becomes `rebar.reconciler` with no shim (ADR 0083, ADR 0111). Cites are on origin/main c0cf1022671; the enumerated sites and file lists are in the revision-2 comment.

## Approach
1. `git mv src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler src/rebar/reconciler`; a throwaway codemod over `src`, `scripts`, `infra`, `tests`, docs and `README.md` rewrites imports, quoted keys, path joins (the package is now the engine dir's sibling), private `rebar_reconciler_<x>` cache keys and prose. The test directories `tests/{unit,integration}/rebar_reconciler/` keep their names (next story).
2. In-package: delete `_loader.py`; every loader prologue and by-path sibling loader becomes `importlib.import_module("rebar.reconciler.<mod>")` or a plain import, keeping loader function names so patch targets survive. `__main__.py` keeps `_load_sibling_keyed`/`_try_load_step` as patchable seams over `import_module` and drops its `rebar` bootstrap fallback. Two runtime fallbacks are pure by-path artifacts and are deleted: the reconcile-absent no-op and `_advisory = None` on `ImportError` (likewise `manifest_renderer`'s `retry_budget` fallback). Every module ships inside the package, so the disposition for a genuinely missing module is a hard `ImportError` at import, exit 1 (the existing unrecoverable-error contract), never a silent converged pass. The stderr handler installs on `rebar`; the package NullHandler goes (the `rebar` root has one).
3. `engine_env` drops the PYTHONPATH prepend and only pins `REBAR_ROOT`; `engine_dir()` stays for `jira-capability-probe.py` and `resources/`.
4. Out-of-package callers import directly: delete `_lib_ops._engine_module` (src callers and the six test modules that import it switch to `import_module`: `tests/interfaces/facades/test_bridge_programmatic.py`, `tests/integration/test_ensure_project_mapping.py`, `tests/unit/test_reconciler_shadow_package_ordering.py`, `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_access_check_{client_seam,jql_backoff,transport_unavailable}.py`), `_bridge_commands._ref_lock_module`, and `mcp_server._load_engine_mode` with the unread `ctx.MODE_CAPS`/`ctx.Mode` handles (their kwargs go from `scripts/gen_mcp_reference.py` and every ctx a test builds: `tests/unit/test_{gen_mcp_reference,cross_session_mcp,audit_read,read_freshness_parity,plan_review_explain,bridge_projects_surfaces_heldout,mcp_plan_review_status}.py`); the `sys.path.insert` sites and the `_engine_support/bridge_fsck_{drift,visibility}.py` and infra-script loaders become plain imports.
5. Scripts that hardcode the directory are re-pointed.
6. `pyproject.toml` is NOT edited: any edit trips the Gerrit pip-audit dependency-map lane on the open advisories (unhelpful-supersmart-chrysalis). The old T201 glob stays as a dead entry; the 99 reconciler `print()` sites get inline `# noqa: T201` (`ruff check --select T201 --add-noqa`); follow-up likable-waterworn-willet moves the glob once the advisories clear.
7. Type fixes, required by the move (once `rebar.reconciler.*` annotations resolve instead of widening to `Any`, `make typecheck` fails without them), no behaviour change: `AcliClient.update_issue`'s first parameter renamed `remote_id` to match the `TicketTransport` port (no keyword caller), and a few annotations/`assert is not None` (comment). The two `sync-hardening-proposal` comment rewrites the docs/ADR epic assigned to this story (`inbound_differ.py`, `apply_handlers.py`, third comment) land here too; the epic's S1 line admits both.
8. Tests, mechanical: by-path helpers become `import_module`; `sys.modules` seeds, namespace stubs, engine-dir constants and `sys.path.insert` go; the module-level shadow-package bridges in `tests/unit/conftest.py` and `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/conftest.py` go (fixtures stay); private module copies become `monkeypatch.setattr` on the shared module (no `importlib.reload`). `tests/_engine_path.py`, `_one_engine_root` and `test_engine_root_convention.py` stay, adjusted to `src/rebar/reconciler` (next story deletes them). Rewritten or deleted tests are listed in the comment.
9. Docs: maintained docs and `README.md` spell `rebar.reconciler`; `docs/architecture.md`'s package-layout section describes the new layout; BREAKING entries in `CHANGELOG.md` and `docs/release-notes.md`; regenerate `docs/env-vars.md`.
10. `.github/complexity-baseline.json`: re-spell the 6 engine keys under `ceilings` to `src/rebar/reconciler/...`, ceilings unchanged, written through `render_baseline` (sorted). Operator-sanctioned; the CI `Complexity-baseline lock` step rejects the six added keys by design and the operator force-submits (landing instruction in the comments).
Rollback: one atomic commit (rename, codemod, re-spell); `git revert` restores `rebar_reconciler`, every loader, the PYTHONPATH prepend and the six old keys together. No expand-contract window: the old name is never importable beside the new one.

## Scope
`src/rebar/reconciler/**` (moved), the out-of-package callers and prose sites listed in the revision-2 comment, the scripts and infra script there, `.github/complexity-baseline.json`, tests per step 8, the maintained `docs/*.md` listed there, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`. Out of scope: `pyproject.toml` (step 6), the rest of `_cli/` (CLI epic), the test-side loader complex and test-package rename (next story), any engine behaviour change.

## Testing
`python -c "import rebar.reconciler, rebar.reconciler.__main__"`; `python -m rebar.reconciler --help` exits 0 with no PYTHONPATH; `pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler tests/interfaces tests/scripts -q`; `make typecheck`; `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check` prints `new=0 increased=0`; `ruff check --select T201 --isolated src/rebar/reconciler` is clean. Edge greps: `git grep -nE '\brebar_reconciler\b' -- src scripts infra` and the same over `docs README.md ':!docs/adr' ':!docs/experiments' ':!docs/archive' ':!docs/release-notes.md'` return only references to the not-yet-renamed `tests/{unit,integration}/rebar_reconciler` test paths (historical release-note entries keep the name they shipped under).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/` does not exist (`git ls-tree`).
- [ ] `src/rebar/reconciler/__init__.py` exists and `src/rebar/reconciler/_loader.py` does not (`git ls-tree`).
- [ ] `git grep -nE 'spec_from_file_location|lazy_load\(' -- src infra` returns only the `src/rebar/graph/_loader.py` docstring.
- [ ] Both edge greps in Testing match nothing beyond the listed exceptions.
- [ ] `python -m rebar.reconciler preview --repo-root <tmp>` runs from a fresh venv with no `PYTHONPATH` (`tests/interfaces/facades/test_bridge_cli_heldout.py` subprocess case).
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0 apart from the known arm64 pandoc host failures.
- [ ] `check_complexity_baseline.py --check` prints `new=0 increased=0`.
- [ ] `.github/complexity-baseline.json` holds the 6 `src/rebar/reconciler/` keys, sorted, at unchanged ceilings.
- [ ] `ruff check --select T201 --isolated src/rebar/reconciler` reports nothing.
- [ ] `git diff --stat origin/main -- pyproject.toml` is empty.
- [ ] `python scripts/gen_env_registry.py --check` is clean.
